prompt: An unknown with molecular formula C₃H₇N gives the IR and ¹H NMR below. Identify.
explanation: C₃H₇N fits all four, but IR distinguishes them: 1° amine shows TWO N-H bands near 3300-3500 (sym + asym stretch); 2° amine shows ONE N-H band; 3° amine shows NO N-H band. NMR: 1-propylamine gives triplet (3H, CH₃), sextet (2H, mid-CH₂), triplet (2H, CH₂N), and a broad 2H NH₂.
